info.name: gda-importer
info.summary: GDA Importer is the default project generated by GDA Cookiecutter. GDA Importer contains all the boilerplate you need to create a Python package according to the best-practices of Geometric Data Analytics, Inc.

info.name: gda-importer
info.summary: GDA Importer provides simple command-line utilities that aide the installation of Python packages.
